doc: The original IOMobileFramebufferLegacy (com.apple.iokit.IOMobileGraphicsFamily, below IOMobileFramebufferService and IOMobileFramebuffer): the family's swap queue, user client and power states, which NativeLegacyDisplay subclasses in place of Apple's platform display driver. Its virtuals beyond IOService's carry no PAC name we know, so each kind's table places them by hint.

newUserClient.decl: IOReturn newUserClient(task_t, void *, UInt32, IOUserClient **) override

isMainDisplay.doc: Whether this framebuffer is the main display (the family reads two flag bytes of its own).

getDotPitch.doc: The family's implementation assumes an AppleARMIODevice provider and reads its dot-pitch property.

supportedFrameInfo.decl: virtual IOReturn supportedFrameInfo(uint32_t, uint32_t *count, char *key, uint32_t *mask) = 0

getDisplayDimensions.doc: The mode the family holds (displayWidth, displayHeight).

startHardware.doc: The family's answers false; a platform driver brings the display pipe up.

kickSwapQueue.doc: Called whenever the swap queue changes (a new swap, a vsync client registered): the platform driver presents from it.

completeCurrentSwap.doc: Retires the current swap (swapQueueCurrent) and moves the queue on.

validateSwap.doc: The family's refuses every swap; a platform driver accepts those it can show.

collectCompletionReports.decl: virtual IOReturn collectCompletionReports(uint32_t, void *, uint32_t *count, uint32_t) = 0
collectCompletionReports.doc: Called by the completion path with optional outputs; its IOReturn is ignored.

setDisplayPowerState.doc: The power-state setter: change is {skipRequested, requested, skipPowered, powered, changed} (four uint32 and a byte); a word not skipped that differs is stored and the change is announced.

getGammaTable.doc: Selector 27: the 3x257 gamma table out (0xc0c bytes). The family answers kIOReturnUnsupported.

setGammaTable.doc: Selector 17: a 3x257 gamma table in (0xc0c bytes). The family answers kIOReturnUnsupported.

getMatrix.doc: Selector 54: a 3x3 S31.32 matrix out (0x48 bytes) for a pipe location; QuartzCore asks for 0x100 and takes identity when refused. The family answers kIOReturnUnsupported.

setMatrix.decl: virtual IOReturn setMatrix(uint32_t location, const void *matrix)
setMatrix.doc: Selector 55: a 3x3 S31.32 matrix (0x48 bytes) for a pipe location; QuartzCore sends True Tone and Night Shift at location 9. The family answers kIOReturnUnsupported.

setContrast.doc: Selector 84: a float (the 4-byte structure input), CADisplay's contrast. The family answers kIOReturnUnsupported; AppleCLCD always succeeds.

setColorRemapMode.doc: Selector 51, and the family's white-on-black (selector 19: 1 or 0): QuartzCore sends grayscale ? (inverted ? 4 : 3) : inverted. The family answers kIOReturnUnsupported; AppleCLCD takes 0-4 and refuses the rest with kIOReturnBadArgument.

getColorRemapMode.doc: Selector 57. The family writes 6 and answers kIOReturnUnsupported; AppleCLCD gives the current mode.

setBrightnessCorrection.doc: Selector 50's first scalar: a 16.16 luminance factor QuartzCore sends with each True Tone matrix. The family answers kIOReturnUnsupported.

swapSetColorMatrix.decl: virtual IOReturn swapSetColorMatrix(const void *matrix, uint32_t location, uint32_t flags)
swapSetColorMatrix.doc: Selector 69: pre-offsets, 3x3, post-offsets (15 S31.32 words) or null for identity; QuartzCore sends the accessibility matrix at location 2, flags 0, offsets 0. The family answers kIOReturnUnsupported.

setAccessibilityScale.doc: SetParameter 3 (selector 68), which QuartzCore sends after its accessibility matrix: a 16.16 scale, Reduce White Point's. The family answers kIOReturnUnsupported.

platformPipeForward.doc: Apple's platform driver (UnifiedPipeline) forwards it to its display pipe backend. Only a platform display driver implements it, and nothing here should reach it.

platformInternalPlug.doc: Reached from IOAVHandlerInternalDisplay::plugEvent_async_gated; UnifiedPipeline answers kIOReturnUnsupported. Only a platform display driver implements it, and nothing here should reach it.

platformInternalUnplug.doc: The internal display plug pair's second; UnifiedPipeline answers kIOReturnUnsupported. Only a platform display driver implements it, and nothing here should reach it.

platformFrameInfoNotify.doc: The frame-info notification (EnableNotifications type 3, selector 72) of one client turning on, and off again when it is disabled or the client goes away; the caller ignores what it returns. UnifiedPipeline forwards it to its display pipe, which then sends the client the keys supportedFrameInfo published at each frame.

platformHotPlug.doc: Reached from hotPlug_notify_gated; UnifiedPipeline forwards it to its display pipe backend. Only a platform display driver implements it, and nothing here should reach it.

platformRefreshRates.doc: Reached from hotPlug_notify_gated's refresh frequencies; UnifiedPipeline does nothing. Only a platform display driver implements it, and nothing here should reach it.

platformIdleWithoutClients.doc: Reached from disp_has_no_clients_gated and swap_wait_gated; UnifiedPipeline answers a flag of its own. Only a platform display driver implements it, and nothing here should reach it.

swapQueueCurrent.doc: The framebuffer's current swap (a request pointer): the one completeCurrentSwap retires.

swapQueueHead.doc: The framebuffer's swap queue head (a tail queue of requests, linked through swapNext/swapPrevious): its address is the first request's previous link.

swapQueueTail.doc: The swap queue's tail: the address of the last request's next link (the head's address when empty).

swapNext.doc: A request's next link in the swap queue.

swapPrevious.doc: A request's previous link: the address of the link that points at it.

swapSourceRects.doc: A request's source rectangles, four int32 x, y, w, h per layer (16 bytes each).

swapDestinationRects.doc: A request's destination rectangles, as swapSourceRects.

swapTransforms.doc: A request's layer transforms, a uint32 per layer (& 7).

swapUpdated.doc: A request's updated mask: bits 0-3 the layers, bit 31 the background.

swapReady.doc: A request's ready mask: bit i once layer i's IOSurface fence signalled.

swapOptions.doc: A request's three option words (all 0 for a plain swap).

swapSize.doc: The display width and height (two uint32) the request was submitted for.

swapSurfaces.doc: A request's IOSurface per layer (updated layers only, at validateSwap).

swapEffectiveSurfaces.doc: The IOSurface per layer each request shows, the family's fill after validateSwap (inherited for layers it does not update).

swapsCompleted.doc: The framebuffer's last completed swap id (uint32): the completion path stores each retired swap's id.

swapsPresented.doc: The framebuffer's last presented swap id (uint32): the completed id, when the swap was shown.

framesCompleted.doc: The framebuffer's completed frame count (uint32), one per swap the completion path retires shown.

vsyncClientList.doc: The framebuffer's vsync client list head (a pointer): set while a client wants vsync messages; native_legacy_vsync_notify walks it.

native_legacy_vsync_notify.decl: void native_legacy_vsync_notify(void *display, uint64_t timestamp, uint64_t continuousTime, uint64_t interval)
native_legacy_vsync_notify.doc: The family's vsync message sender (IOMobileFramebufferLegacy's own): every client on vsyncClients gets the vsync message; a 0 continuous time or interval is filled in from the framebuffer.
